law: docs/workflow.md: every transition names its actor class, its evidence duty, its failure class and its gate
owner: 2026-09-12: "the hook is supposed to have matrix of checks and guarantees - its a framework for verification"; "if its not an abstracted boundary - then we don't speak the same language"

rows.trigger: a write to a path under a code root, by a tool or a statement
rows.evidence: an open hand grant whose scope covers the path (the ledger row)

rows.trigger: rm -r of records, state, worktrees or .git
rows.evidence: none: data is kept

refuse.needed: leave it; move it under .dev/tmp with a note if it is in the way

rows.trigger: a grep, rg or git grep search over a code root
rows.evidence: a Graft query, a count or a file list instead

rows.trigger: unittest given a path instead of discovery
rows.evidence: the discover form

refuse.expected: the discover form (python3 -m unittest discover -s <tests dir> -p <file>) or ops/bin/suites.sh

rows.trigger: launch.py run without the dispatcher
rows.evidence: the dispatcher, or a grant for a read

rows.trigger: --model or --effort on a dispatcher call
rows.evidence: the lane conf's MODEL_ and EFFORT_ rows

rows.trigger: a --scope-file or --input missing or empty
rows.evidence: the files, present and non-empty

rows.trigger: --scope-file over SCOPE_CAP
rows.evidence: the file's size against the conf

rows.trigger: an implement scope naming the whole suite
rows.evidence: the bucket's tests named

rows.trigger: a write job whose inputs carry no first-run walkthrough
rows.evidence: the walkthrough section in an input

rows.trigger: a worktree whose merge-forward from the trunk would conflict
rows.evidence: git merge-tree clean; the dispatcher merges behind forward

rows.trigger: harness contracts do not vet as a package
rows.evidence: cue vet exit 0

rows.trigger: a launch without LAUNCHER_PIN, DISPATCH_TIMEOUT and WF_AGENT
rows.evidence: the three exported in the run script

rows.trigger: a driver job sent straight to dispatch.sh
rows.evidence: the ladder, or an unscoped open grant

rows.trigger: a new worktree, branch, dispatch, ladder start or PR aimed outside the lock
rows.evidence: the deliverable lock naming the branch

rows.trigger: gh pr ready or gh pr merge
rows.evidence: a ## Proof section naming corpus rows present at the head and a green ci run on that head

rows.trigger: git commit, merge, cherry-pick, rebase, revert or am on the trunk or the release branch, or a push to them; a merge of <remote>/<trunk> that git reports as a fast-forward (--ff-only, or HEAD an ancestor of it) creates no commit and passes (LD-38)
rows.evidence: the session branch

refuse.expected: a commit on a session branch (lane/session-<date>-<id>)
refuse.needed: cut the session branch and commit there: git worktree add ../wt/ag-session-<date>-<id> -b lane/session-<date>-<id> origin/<trunk>; python3 ops/conductor/tools/deliverable.py add lane/session-<date>-<id> --why '<the owner's words>'; one draft PR at close. No grant lifts this row; on the main checkout, git merge --ff-only origin/<trunk> alone passes, and trunk-forward.py runs it at every session start

rows.trigger: a commit message, PR body or comment, record or law page with a claim and no reading beside it
rows.evidence: a sha, a record id, a P- row, #PR, a run id, Ran N tests, or the words not measured, in the paragraph

refuse.expected: every paragraph that claims (enforced, done, landed, merged, green, impossible, verified, fixed, ...) to carry its reading beside the claim: a sha, a record id, a P- row, #PR, a run id, "Ran N tests", or the words not measured
refuse.needed: measure it and cite the reading in the same paragraph, or write that it is not measured; no grant lifts this row (owner, 2026-09-12: "you have to enforce it before you state it as fact - with evidence")

rows.trigger: git push with --force, --force-with-lease or -f
rows.evidence: a new commit on the branch; pushed history is never rewritten

refuse.expected: a push that adds commits (branches are never rewritten)
refuse.needed: push a new commit; never rewrite a pushed branch. This row exists only as data in ops/devlane/hooks/boundaries.json (owner, 2026-09-12: adding a condition is adding a row)

rows.trigger: a write creating a JSON or text store under the lane's state directory, or a placement file declaring state.engine file
rows.evidence: rows in state.db through the state engine (ops/conductor/tools/machine.py); a file only as a record or apparatus a tool writes from its rows, declared in its placement file

refuse.expected: state as rows in state.db through the state engine (ops/conductor/tools/machine.py); under the state directory only a .db, or a record a tool writes from its rows
refuse.needed: declare the machine as data in the tool and write through machine.py create and move (the state skill, .claude/skills/state/SKILL.md); a placement declaring file needs the owner's word and a row in FILE_BACKED in ops/conductor/tests/test_state_placement.py. No grant lifts this row (owner, 2026-09-13: "i need to prevent future default to files when SQLite is better option")

rows.trigger: at Stop, a reply that says done, complete, finished, landed, merged or solved and carries no deliverable.py line (done lane/..., the done verb's target refusal, or show's target line)
rows.evidence: python3 ops/conductor/tools/deliverable.py done <branch>, its line or its refusal pasted in the reply; the lock's target lines

refuse.expected: a reply that says done to carry the lock's reading: the `done <branch>: ...` line of `python3 ops/conductor/tools/deliverable.py done <branch>`, or its `target: expected the measure to read ...` refusal, or show's `target <branch>: until ...; reading ...; met|short` line (a sha or a PR number is not that reading)
refuse.needed: run python3 ops/conductor/tools/deliverable.py done <branch> and paste its line, or its refusal with the reading; a branch with no target sets one first (deliverable.py add BRANCH --why '<the owner's words>' --measure CMD --until TEXT). Three blocks per session, then the stop passes with the reading logged (owner, 2026-09-15: \"I need confidence that my orders are being carried out\")

rows.trigger: a write to a wall path (.github/workflows, ops/bin/suites.sh, probes.py, laneconf.py, the hook registry, rows and engine, ops/devlane/hooks/tests/, ops/testkit/, ops/devlane/task/jobs.json) without a grant of lever class wall; or a wall grant writing a non-wall code path
rows.evidence: an open grant of lever class wall leading the command; the session touches wall paths only

rows.trigger: a write creating a module under a tests/ directory whose text neither imports ops.testkit nor carries `# testkit: exempt <reason>` in its first ten lines
rows.evidence: the kit import (from ops.testkit import ...), or the exemption with its reason; docs/tests.md rule 1

refuse.expected: a new test module that imports the kit (from ops.testkit import World, run, ...) or declares `# testkit: exempt <reason>` in its first ten lines (docs/tests.md rule 1)
refuse.needed: import the kit, or declare the exemption with its reason. No grant lifts this row: the kit is the one place test machinery lives (D-TESTKIT-1)

engine: ops/devlane/hooks/claude/engine.py evaluates rows with engine: true at the event they bind to; rows with engine: false are still carried by matrix.py's code and are declared here so a class nobody declared cannot refuse

bindings.note: the session binds engine.py to these events in .claude/settings.json; a row's event names which binding evaluates it
PreToolUse: Bash (after unsafe-command and matrix, in context-precheck.sh)

escapes.none: no grant lifts the row; the refusal stands
escapes.grant: an open hand grant leading the command whose scope covers the path lifts it
escapes.unscoped-grant: an open grant with no scope lifts it
escapes.ask: the row answers ask instead of deny: the harness puts the action in front of the owner, and only the owner's click passes it. Only where the action is critical, a forced push or a prune (owner, 2026-09-12: "i don't want asks unless they're critical"); a hard row whose remedy is the agent's own (a branch, a reading, the proof) is escape none and denies
